summary: Iteration 2 testing. Backend: 32/32 pytest pass (8 new iteration-2 tests + 24 regression). Frontend Expo web preview tested on mobile viewport. Scenarios (king_dash kd1, swap_move sm1), rating-trend on profile, and play rule modal with timer chips all work. BUT four iteration-2 UI features are broken/missing and must be fixed by main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: confirm-abort-yes / confirm-abort-no modal is not rendered. setConfirmAbort(true) is called on play-abort tap but no <Modal visible={confirmAbort}> exists in the JSX tree.
confirm-new-yes / confirm-new-no modal is not rendered. State exists but no Modal consumes it. play-new onPress fires setConfirmNew(true) which silently does nothing.

play-new button never appears. The conditional uses rcRef.current.historySAN().length (a mutable ref, not state) which does not trigger a React re-render, so the action bar continues to render play-abort forever. Verified: after player move + AI reply, play-abort is still in the DOM and play-new is NOT. Should be driven by a state variable like movesPairs or a movesCount state.

play-elo-change block is not rendered in the Game Over modal. eloChange state is declared (line 60) but the game-over modal JSX (lines 450-478) shows only XP/coins reward text — no ELO before/after/delta block with testID play-elo-change.

No inline 'thinking...' sub-label was detected in opponent strip during AI move (body text scanned ~250ms and ~3s after player move did not contain the word 'thinking'). A large absolute-positioned element (300x400+) was detected while aiThinking=true — may be a full-screen overlay that the iteration-2 spec explicitly forbids. Please verify OpponentStrip shows 'thinking…' and that NO full-screen overlay blocks the board.

issues: Deprecation warnings persist: textShadow* and expo-audio version mismatch (expo-audio@55.0.14 vs expected ~1.1.1). Non-blocking.

action_items: Add <Modal visible={confirmAbort}> with buttons testID confirm-abort-yes (calls router.replace('/home') or newGame) and confirm-abort-no (setConfirmAbort(false)).
Add <Modal visible={confirmNew}> with buttons testID confirm-new-yes (newGame) and confirm-new-no (setConfirmNew(false)).
Drive Abort-vs-New-game rendering from React state (e.g. a movesCount state updated whenever a move is pushed), not rcRef.current.historySAN(). Current ref-based check never triggers a re-render.
In the Game Over <Modal>, render a block with testID='play-elo-change' showing rating_before, rating_after and a colored +/- delta from the eloChange state.
Replace any full-screen spinner during aiThinking with an inline 'thinking…' sub-label inside the OpponentStrip only (no Modal/overlay).
(Optional) `npx expo install --check` to silence expo-audio version warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Using refs (rcRef.current.historySAN().length) to drive conditional rendering is a common React bug — refs do not trigger re-renders. Convert to state.
eloChange state is set when a match completes but never surfaced in UI — orphan state.
confirmAbort / confirmNew states are wired to onPress handlers but the corresponding Modals were never added — incomplete feature.

rca_of_issue: play-new never appears because line 393 of play.tsx uses `rcRef.current.historySAN().length === 0` — a mutable ref read, not subscribed state. React doesn't re-render on ref mutations, so the Abort button remains mounted forever. Fix: introduce `const [moveCount, setMoveCount] = useState(0)` updated inside commitMove/undo/newGame, then branch on `moveCount === 0`. Similarly, confirmAbort/confirmNew need Modal components to render their true state with the spec'd testIDs.
